resources.string: The selected JPEG or PNG is returned automatically to the verified app after validation.

Photo unavailable, cancelled, expired, too large or unsupported. Only JPEG/PNG up to 8 MiB, 4096 pixels per side and 12 megapixels are accepted. Cameras requiring seekable files or reopening output are unsupported. No thumbnail fallback is used. Streaming photo providers require Android 11 or newer.

Android handles photo selection or capture. The validated photo is returned automatically to the verified app. Selection may use a cloud provider. Original image metadata, potentially including location, is retained. Jarvys does not save to the gallery; the external camera may keep its own copy. Access is temporary and cancellation does not recall copies. An interrupted operation is closed automatically before the next photo interaction.
